definitions.explanation: The year two years ago from the current year.

examples.japanese: おととし{日本|にほん}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to Japan the year before last.

examples.japanese: おととしの{夏|なつ}は{暑|あつ}かった。
examples.english: The summer of the year before last was hot.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はおととし{大学|だいがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}した。
examples.english: He graduated from university the year before last.

examples.japanese: おととし{結婚|けっこん}した{友達|ともだち}に{赤|あか}ちゃんが{生|う}まれた。
examples.english: A friend who got married the year before last had a baby.

examples.japanese: おととしの{冬|ふゆ}にスキーに{行|い}ったのが{楽|たの}しかった。
examples.english: Going skiing in the winter of the year before last was fun.

notes:
おととし means 'the year before last' (two years ago).

KANJI:
Written as {一昨年|おととし} in formal contexts. Also read as {一昨年|いっさくねん} in very formal/written Japanese.

YEAR SEQUENCE:
- {一昨年|おととし}: year before last (-2)
- {去年|きょねん}/{昨年|さくねん}: last year (-1)
- {今年|ことし}: this year
- {来年|らいねん}: next year (+1)
- {再来年|さらいねん}: year after next (+2)

SIMILAR PATTERN:
- おととい: day before yesterday
- {昨日|きのう}: yesterday
- {今日|きょう}: today
- {明日|あした}: tomorrow
- {明後日|あさって}: day after tomorrow

USAGE:
More common in spoken Japanese; {一昨年|いっさくねん} is preferred in formal writing.
